content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers look to complete a season-opening sweep, while the Arizona Diamondbacks fight to salvage a game in this NL West showdown.MORE: MLB preseason power rankingsDate: Saturday, February 28, 2026Time: 9:10 p.m. ETTV Channel: SportsNet LA, MLB Arizona Diamondbacks, MLB.TVAdvertisementLos Angeles has come out firing to begin its title defense, jumping to a 2–0 start behind a combination of explosive offense and timely late-game execution. The Dodgers have already taken down Arizona twice—first in a convincing win and then in a tight 5–4 battle highlighted by clutch hitting from Mookie Betts and a go-ahead RBI from Kyle Tucker. With Tyler Glasnow set to take the mound, the Dodgers will look to continue controlling the series with strong pitching and a lineup that can break games open in a single inning, making them heavy favorites to finish the sweep at home.Live Stream Diamondbacks vs DodgersArizona, however, has shown flashes of life despite the 0–2 start, particularly at the plate in Game 2, where they kept pace and created scoring opportunities throughout. Players like Ketel Marte and Alek Thomas have provided key moments, but defensive miscues and missed chances have ultimately cost them.
